title: Beltline Pool adaptive-reuse and building-separation procurement record
code_edition: Unknown (the City OREOI requires current building/fire/accessibility requirements but gives no edition)
document_date: 2025-09-16 OREOI listing; attached brochure deadline revised to 2026-03-02

facts.text: The City OREOI identifies 221 12 Avenue SW as the Beltline Pool, built in 1954 with two storeys plus a basement; the basement includes pool/exercise space and the upper floor contains a gymnasium. Prior renovations are listed for 1991, 2003 and 2013.

The OREOI says the pool and YWCA buildings are adjacent/connected and share a mechanical system located in the Pool building. It estimates base code/building-service requirements to separate the buildings at approximately $3.8 million.

The City says a Pool Building Condition Assessment was completed in 2019 and updated in 2022; base building-code/accessibility upgrades are estimated at approximately $6 million. The source gives lifecycle cost estimates and estimates demolition at $1.6 million, with an additional $2.3 million for YWCA facade restoration.
facts.locator: OREOI PDF p. 5, “Pool Building – key highlights”

facts.text: The City listing says the facilities are not deemed safe for occupancy and that investment is required before occupancy; the OREOI says both buildings must meet current building code, fire-safety-code and accessibility requirements.
facts.locator: OREOI PDF p. 4; official City listing, Overview
